hard_core.definition: every matrix system > 25 % line CER at no_diacritics (analyze_lines A3)

irt_top_quintile.definition: top 20 % of IRT 2PL difficulty b within the set

irt_low_discrimination.definition: point-biserial of line correctness with system ability < 0 (better systems fail it more); R4.1 candidates

dot_dense.definition: top 20 % of dotted letters per letter within the set

oov_heavy.definition: >= 30 % of the line's words absent from the lexicon (/Volumes/PortableSSD/data/lexicon, surface form)

fragments.definition: cleaned GT <= 20 characters, or digits only, or a single word

loose_crops.definition: ink covers < 80 % of the crop height (samples.ink_extent)

leaked.definition: text or image found in the set's own training pool (audit_leakage)
